title: How much higher was average administrator pay than teacher pay in La Grange School District 105 South in 2024-25?
text:
How much higher was average administrator pay than teacher pay in La Grange School District 105 South in 2024-25?
The average school administrator salary in La Grange School District 105 South was $134,258 in the 2024-25 school year, while the average teacher salary was $74,780, according to the Illinois State Board of Education.
La Grange School District 105 South roughly covers schools within Cook County and has a main office in La Grange.
Statewide, the average school administrator salary increased 11.1% over the five years ending in 2024-25 school year, compared with a 15.3% increase in average teacher salary.
New Trier Township High School District 203 had the highest average administrator salary in the state at $200,839, while its average teacher salary was $141,632.
Illinois reported a statewide teacher retention rate of 89.5% for the 2024-25 school year, according to the Illinois Report Card. Teacher vacancies remained a concern, though staffing data showed improvement. The state had 2,943 unfilled teaching positions as of Oct. 1, 2025, down 24% from 3,864 a year earlier, while the statewide teacher vacancy rate fell to 2.1%.
